goal: Prevent untrusted inputs from injecting fake log lines into debug.log
Protects node operators and automated log monitoring tools from forged error and status messages
agreement: Substantive support across multiple revisions with no open objections
Approved central escaping implementation as simpler and protective against injection paths (ryanofsky)
Favored global newline escaping to protect strings from external daemons (davidgumberg)
Verified by testing RPC log injection prevention (polespinasa)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it prevents log injection where untrusted inputs can forge arbitrary debug log entries
Stops restricted RPC callers and external daemons from faking node errors or misleading monitoring
